conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Lisa from Amazon Customer Security. I hope you're well today. I'm calling because we've noticed a potential issue with your Amazon account involving a recent login from an unfamiliar device.
Oh my, I haven't logged in lately. What kind of device was it?
It appears to be a mobile device in another state. I know this can be concerning, but please don't worry, we're here to help you secure your account and prevent any unauthorized purchases.
Thank you, I've had a lot going on lately and I'm not sure I can handle another problem.

Of course, I completely understand. Let's take this one step at a time. For your security, may I confirm your full name and the best phone number to reach you, just to make sure I'm speaking with the correct account holder?
My name is Helen Walker, and this number is 617-555-2143.
Thank you, Ms. Walker. I can see that your account recently had a purchase attempt for a $1,200 camera. Does that sound familiar to you?
No, I haven't bought anything like that. I don't even own a camera.

That's what we suspected. I'll make sure we freeze that order. To help you further, I'd like to connect you to my supervisor, Tom, who can assist in reversing any unauthorized charges and protecting your funds. May I transfer you?
Yes, please. I'm really worried now.

Hi Helen, this is Tom, Amazon Security Supervisor. I'm so sorry for the stress this has caused. It's my job to make sure you're safe and that your money is protected. Can I ask if you've noticed any other strange activity on your bank or credit card recently?
I don't think so, but to be honest, I haven't checked lately.
That's perfectly okay. We'll help you with that. First, for your protection, I'll need to verify the last four digits of the card you use most often on Amazon. Can you provide those for me?
I think it's 2579.

Thank you. Let me mark that for our records. Now, because your account may have been compromised, we recommend temporarily locking your Amazon wallet and refunding any pending balances to you directly. This is a standard safety procedure.
How does that work? I'm not very good with computers.
Not a problem at all. I can guide you through each step. Would you be able to access your Amazon account from your phone or computer right now?
Yes, I'm on my laptop.
Great. Please log in to your Amazon account. Let me know once you're in so I can walk you through the refund process. I'll stay on the line the whole time to answer any questions.
Okay, I'm logged in.
Excellent, thank you. Now, I'm going to send a secure link to your email. Please click it, it will open an Amazon Verification Portal where you can confirm your identity and process the refund.
Alright, I see the link and opened it. It's asking for a verification code.
Perfect. The code is 4412. Enter that and you should see a screen mentioning 'Refund Request', do you see that?
Yes, it says to enter refund details.
That's right. Please enter your regular bank account where you'd like the funds to be returned. This is completely secure and standard procedure during account recovery.
Alright, I put in my checking account number.

Thank you. The portal should now ask for a small verification payment, this is just to confirm your ownership of the account and will be immediately refunded. It might give options like Zelle, PayPal, or Amazon gift cards. Which option do you feel most comfortable with?
I've used PayPal before, but I have a physical Amazon gift card, too.

Both work perfectly. If you'd like, you can enter the Amazon gift card code in the portal, again, this is only to verify your account, and the balance will be returned to you right after verification is complete.
Okay, the card number is 6111 2222 3333 4444. I entered it.
Thank you so much, Helen. You've done everything right. The portal may now ask you to confirm a small transaction, just approve it and we'll process your refund.
It's asking me to approve $500. Is that normal?
Yes, that's just the security hold, not an actual charge. It will be reversed as soon as your account is cleared, usually within 24 hours. Please approve it so we can finish securing your account.
Alright, I approved it.
Wonderful. Everything is processing now. To wrap up, the system might send you a text with a link, please follow that to confirm your identity one last time.
I just got it, and I clicked the link.

All set, Helen. Your refund and account protection are in progress. You have my direct line if you have any questions or need further help. Thank you for your patience, and please try not to worry, we're here to make sure you're safe.
Thank you for helping me. I hope this will all be sorted soon.
Absolutely, Helen. You'll receive an email confirmation as soon as your funds are restored and your account is secure. Have a peaceful rest of your day.
